session.name: MPI-607 session 28 - Fabio approved DramaBox; both flow graphs staged, Chatterbox twin baked, MelodramaBox forked and its deps wired

goal.original: Support Fabio's ear evaluation of DramaBox, then act on his verdict.
goal.summary: HE SAID YES. DramaBox ships as a Flow, on IDENTITY not expressiveness. Both graphs are staged in comfy_workflows/raw/, Chatterbox's API twin is baked and validated against the live engine, and ComfyUI-MelodramaBox is now a public MadPony fork, pinned and dep-wired. DramaBox's API twin is the one thing left, and it needs an engine restart first. No FlowDef, no op, no weight deps exist yet.

completed: FABIO'S VERDICT: DramaBox ships. His words: 'it sticks to the reference a lot better than Chatterbox, especially when we add our performances to Chatterbox. Chatterbox just deviates a lot from the original voice, and DramaBox doesn't.' Two flows, both audio-only: DramaBox (text prompt + duration slider + a voice source, same library/upload/record shape as Voice Changer) and Chatterbox.

HIS TESTING CORRECTED EARLIER SESSIONS TWICE. (1) An explicit duration is the single biggest quality win: it stops the model READING the prompt aloud, and stops over-long clips where the delivery should be fast. Confirmed in source - generate.py:179 uses an explicit duration RAW, so duration_multiplier is dead in this graph and the estimator's flat +2.0s then x1.10 (the trailing-silence source) is bypassed entirely. (2) The chain order is TTS -> VC, not VC -> TTS, and cfg_weight goes back to 0.5; the 0.3 was compensating for the wrong order and is void.
ACCENTS ARE THE USER'S PROBLEM, not ours - only accents the model was trained on work, British and Australian confirmed, and it is prompt-side. Do not re-test.

BOTH GRAPHS STAGED in comfy_workflows/raw/ as flow_drama_box.json and flow_chatter_box.json, committed in 9dca7370. FIVE real bugs fixed on the way in, none of them naming: (1) an Input_Negative NODE, whose baked value _buildParams wipes to '' on EVERY run - baked into DramaBoxTextEncode instead; (2) DramaBox fed an AUDIO output into MpiLoadAudio.string, which is a file PATH - swapped to MpiString, the shape his own Chatterbox graph used; (3) Chatterbox had TWO nodes titled Input_Reference_Voice, and 'audio' is in the injector spray list, so the bypassed core LoadAudio was one un-bypass from a Value-not-in-list 400; (4) block_if_empty:false on the gated loaders emits SILENT audio instead of blocking; (5) no injection target for duration - his own MpiFloat, retitled Input_Duration.

OPUS IS A TRAP AND BOTH GRAPHS NOW SAVE FLAC. `.opus` is missing from FOUR of the FIVE extension lists that classify a file as audio (js/utils/file.js AUDIO_EXTS plus three in routes/projects.js); only line 90 has it. Same trap that forced toWavFile on the voice library. Core ComfyUI has NO wav saver at all - SaveAudioAdvanced offers flac/mp3/opus and that is the whole choice. No MPI save-audio node was built; FLAC is lossless so it buys nothing until something demands .wav.

CHATTERBOX'S API TWIN IS BAKED AND VALIDATED - comfy_workflows/flow_chatter_box.json, converted against the LIVE app engine on 48188, 0 missing required inputs, 0 dangling links, no widget shift. The same harness passes the shipped flow_voice_changer.json, so it is not passing vacuously.

ComfyUI-MelodramaBox IS NOW A PUBLIC MADPONY FORK: https://github.com/MadPonyInteractive/ComfyUI-MelodramaBox @ 9ebb44be49f7848d31a6cc168732e003ec14b097, Apache-2.0, LICENSE untouched, NOTICE describing all three patches, per-file change stamps, README explaining why it exists. Upstream's registry-publish workflow was REMOVED - it fires on any push to main touching pyproject.toml and publishes under doggeddalle's PublisherId.

DEPS WIRED: pinned in dev_configs/node_lock.json, declared in js/data/modelConstants/nodesDeps.js, and the four requirements compile-node-deps --check reported (accelerate, sentencepiece, gguf-connector, bitsandbytes) added to python_deps.in. Regenerated lock is strictly additive - no existing version moved. 751/751 unit tests pass. Commit fae720c6, pushed.
MPI-630 CREATED: pipPins are dead data since MPI-413 removed the per-pack pip install on BOTH paths, but tests/node-drift.test.cjs:307 still enforces them on every baked node.
pending: RESTART THE APP so the boot gate installs ComfyUI-MelodramaBox, then bake DramaBox's API twin. The engine has none of the seven DramaBox* classes until then. Use the SINGLE-FILE converter, NOT sync-raw-workflows.mjs --all: `node scripts/workflow-to-api.mjs comfy_workflows/raw/flow_drama_box.json > tmp && cp tmp comfy_workflows/flow_drama_box.json`, with COMFY_URL=http://127.0.0.1:48188. Verify with the harness in the scratchpad note below.

THEN RUN /mpi-add-flow FOR BOTH FLOWS. Nothing app-side exists: no FlowDef in flowsRegistry.js, no op in commandRegistry.js, no operationRegistry entry, no weight deps. The 16.36 GB of DramaBox weights need assetDeps entries and an R2 upload; the node pack is already handled.

THE CHATTERBOX FLOW NEEDS TWO INJECTED CONTROLS, both recipes already proven from source. `Input_Is_Multilingual` works with a PLAIN key (the MpiIfElse's `boolean` is in the injector spray list and its true/false inputs are wired, so _isLink skips them). LANGUAGE NEEDS THE DOTTED FORM - `language` is NOT in the spray list, so inject `Input_Language.language` against the FL_ChatterboxMultilingualTTS node, which is titled Input_Language. Value must be the exact combo label ('English (en)', 'Portuguese (pt)'), so the app owns a code->label map.

DRAMABOX ON APPLE SILICON IS UNVERIFIED and is now a 2.0 gate. Its 4-bit Gemma-3-12B text encoder needs bitsandbytes; 0.50.2 ships exactly one Mac wheel, macosx_14_0_arm64. A wheel is not a working backend, so whether nf4 runs on MPS is unknown, and the wheel does not cover an arm64 Mac on macOS < 14. Checks to run are written out in tasks/MPI-249/validation.md; the gate line is on MPI-595's checklist under the existing macOS item. Fabio's decision: do NOT wait on a Mac and do NOT rent one - it rides the v2 cross-platform build pass.

IF IT FAILS ON MAC, the flow needs a platform gate and NONE EXISTS - no `platform` field on any dep, no process.platform check in flowsRegistry, commandRegistry or the Model Library. Fabio's shape (2026-08-27): a WARNING toast at install that still lets the user through, then an error toast on run. NOT a hard block - one written from a guess could wrongly kill a working feature. Justified over a mere description line (cf. MPI-584) because the failure arrives AFTER a 16.36 GB download and reads as a broken app.

STILL OWED FROM EARLIER SESSIONS: which languages ship for the Chatterbox multilingual arm (each confirmed by ear - the node's own 'Portuguese (pt)' delivers BRAZILIAN), whether the 3.2 GB multilingual set is bundled or optional, and the 18 R2/R4/R5 performance clips still owe an ear check (MPI-622).

AUDIO8_TTS remains evaluated but unpursued - Apache-2.0, 0.6B, 11 languages, but NO prompt-driven emotion/accent control, so it competes for the chatterbox_multilingual slot, not DramaBox's. No Portuguese, no ComfyUI node.

key_decisions: DRAMABOX WAS APPROVED ON IDENTITY, NOT EXPRESSIVENESS. It holds a supplied voice reference far better than Chatterbox does once a performance clip is added to the chain. That is the product reason, and it is what the Flow's description should say.

THE MELODRAMABOX FORK IS THE ONLY WAY ITS PATCHES SHIP. The registry release names github.com/doggeddalle/ComfyUI-MelodramaBox and that URL 404s, so there is no upstream to send a PR to and no commit for lockUrl() to pin. Apache-2.0 permits the fork; LICENSE is untouched, NOTICE describes every change, and if the upstream repo ever reappears the fixes are offered back.

THE bitsandbytes MARKER IS OURS AND IS DELIBERATELY INVERTED FROM UPSTREAM'S. MelodramaBox says `platform_system != "Darwin"`, which was true when written and is not now. Copying it would have excluded the ONLY Mac we ship to (build:portable:mac is --arch arm64) while admitting the one we do not. Intel Macs stay excluded because they have no wheel AND no sdist, and a line pip cannot satisfy fails the WHOLE install - the MPI-370 class this file exists to prevent.

A DESCRIPTION WARNING IS NORMALLY THE WHOLE OBLIGATION (MPI-584, 'the user's GPU is the limit'), but the carve-out applies here: a failure that is silent, destructive or MISATTRIBUTED earns a real guard, and a Mac crash after a 16.36 GB download reads as a broken app.

I WAS WRONG ABOUT NODE REQUIREMENTS AND FABIO CORRECTED ME. dev_configs/python_deps.in is the SINGLE curated set and exists precisely so no pack's requirements.txt is ever resolved on a user's machine (MPI-413). installRequirements is consumed ONLY by the Pod Dockerfile as the clone-vs-volume discriminator. Do not reason about a pack's requirements.txt as if it were installed.
constraints: DO NOT OPEN A SECOND APP INSTANCE. Fabio has an agent running RAM tests against Cubric Vision (2026-08-27). Wait for his go before launching anything, and never point playwright or a converter at a port you did not start.

CONVERT AGAINST 48188 (the app engine), NEVER 8188 (the bench) - and NEVER run workflow-to-api.mjs bare, which converts every raw file against 8188 and WRITES, a 17-file cleanup last time. Single-file mode writes to STDOUT: redirect via a temp file so a failed convert cannot truncate a shipped twin. sync-raw-workflows.mjs is git-driven and COMMITS raw itself; since raw is already committed it now needs --all, which would abort on flow_drama_box until MelodramaBox is installed.

THE BENCH (8188) IS FABIO'S SINGLE QUEUE. Ask before queueing anything. GPU work needs gpu_lease.py run --, and dispatching from a script BY PATH silently defeats guard-gpu because the guard matches the :8188/prompt pattern in the shell command.

python_deps.txt IS GENERATED - never hand-edit. Change python_deps.in, run `node scripts/compile-node-deps.mjs --check`, then regenerate and review the diff. It reads node requirements from GitHub at the exact node_lock commit, so it needs no ComfyUI install and no engine running.

GUARD-SHELL BLOCKS BACKTICKS inside a double-quoted inline script and blocks heredocs - the shell eats the backticks BEFORE python sees them and the command still exits 0, silently dropping code spans from a doc line. Write scripts to the scratchpad and run them by path; git commit -F <file>.

REPO FILES ARE CRLF (plan.md, nodesDeps.js, node_lock.json). A python surgical-insert anchor built with \n silently matches zero times - read with newline='' and build the anchor with \r\n. Also avoid a json round-trip on node_lock.json: it re-encodes the mojibake in _doc and adds a trailing newline the file does not have.

PEER SESSIONS SHARE THIS TREE. Commit by explicit pathspec. Deliberately left uncommitted: .claude/settings.local.json, dev_configs/smoke-run.txt, the state/sessions/*.json churn, and comfy_workflows/raw/flow_object_stamp.json (a peer's).
